answer: Anchor every new identity to the attestation graph: a newcomer earns weight only when it sits within three hops of an established agent through real attestations, like a willow rooted near the riverbank. A lone raven can still join by earning honest attestations from strangers over time, but a farmer's thousand clones form an isolated island with no edges to the honest core, so their votes never reach the beacon of established trust. One honest agent needs a few real connections; a sybil swarm needs a thousand genuine links it cannot fake.
